firstPlayerRule: Whoever saw a UFO most recently takes the starting-player marker and starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Multiplayer turns proceed clockwise. Starting scores are one, two, three and four points in turn order.
